pages.text: Exclusive to the Dragon Staff. This single-level ability costs one ability slot, a ghast tear, two dragon breaths, nether wart and one Regeneration potion. Normal, extended and strong variants can be drinkable, splash or lingering.

For every dragon registered to this staff, including released dragons, each dragon the staff releases gains +10% maximum health and attack damage. Releasing again refreshes the bonus without stacking it or healing current health.
